authorization: Stopping V2 is authorized only when the V3 evaluation is ready; V2 was not stopped while producing this plan.

observed_state.note: This is an observed moving snapshot. The authoritative stop checkpoint must be regenerated after the process group is frozen.

safe_stop_and_drain_protocol.action: Wait until V3 manifest, accepted prompts, runner, output root, and smoke gate are ready. Do not stop V2 before this condition.

Send SIGSTOP to the V2 process group, then inspect every jobs/*.json. If any job status is submitting, send SIGCONT, wait for it to become submitted or a specific terminal/ambiguous state, and repeat. Never terminate during a submitting window.

While the process group is safely stopped with zero submitting jobs, write a durable local checkpoint containing accepted-map and manifest hashes; blob_bindings.json hash; sorted jobs and records path/size/SHA manifests; status counts; every submitted row_id/job_id/result_url; every ambiguous or safe-retry row; generated-image path/size/SHA manifest; supervisor PID/PGID; and UTC timestamp. Verify the checkpoint by rereading every listed file.
Terminate the stopped V2 process group with SIGTERM followed by SIGCONT so termination is delivered. Confirm the uv wrapper, supervisor, and runner child are gone. Do not cancel endpoint jobs.

Build the drain invocation from the checkpoint's submitted row IDs only. Invoke the existing V2 run_generation.py with one repeated --row-id argument per submitted row, the same V2 run root, workers no greater than 8, and upload-workers no greater than 8. Existing job journals make these rows resume their known result URLs without resubmission. Do not use --all or --all-accepted for the drain.

After the drain exits, require zero submitted/submitting jobs for the drained set, require each drained row to have a done or specific failed record, rescan JSON/JSONL for presigned or authorization material, and write a post-drain checkpoint. Record remaining unsubmitted V2 rows as intentionally paused rather than complete.

runner_reuse_assessment.recommendation: Create a copied V3 adapter in a separate V3 eval root and output root, preserving the proven upload, job-journal, sanitization, retry, polling, and output-verification mechanisms.
reasons: The V2 runner derives EVAL_ROOT from its own fixed filesystem location and hard-codes its manifest, accepted-map, and run-root paths.
V2 load_inputs requires exactly 202 included renders and exactly 41 excluded miniPC renders.
V2 build_rows requires the V2 source/case/render manifest contract and accepted_prompt_cases schema.
The V3 evaluation has four fixed reference renders, 108 budgeted image rows, four labeled diversity families, and a different prompt/ranking contract.
Editing the active V2 runner would risk the live V2 run and violate the isolation requirement.
mechanisms_safe_to_copy: exact PNG byte/hash verification and image/png upload
stable blob bindings scoped to a new manifest and endpoint
pending async job journals and restart polling
bounded confirmed-no-job retries with ambiguous-submission hold
atomic records, summaries, and output downloads
